faqs.question: Do you manufacture to ISO cavities?
faqs.answer: Catalog cartridges are specified around ISO and SAE cavity families, with custom cavity work when the envelope requires it. Confirm the cavity code on the product page before specifying.

faqs.question: What operating pressure should designers assume?
faqs.answer: The published industrial class on the existing brand site is 350 bar continuous. Individual series may be rated lower; use the product specification table as the design source.

faqs.question: Can you quote from CAD?
faqs.answer: Yes. The request-a-quote flow accepts a description of the application now. File upload will be connected in a later phase; until then, reference drawings in the message field.

faqs.question: Is this website connected to live inventory?
faqs.answer: No. This frontend uses structured mock catalog data so the experience can be reviewed visually. Commercial availability is confirmed during quotation.

products.name: Screw-in Cartridge Valves
products.shortDescription: Compact screw-in valves engineered for ISO and custom cavities in high-duty manifolds.
products.overview: The HCV-SC series is designed for OEMs who need dense hydraulic circuits without sacrificing serviceability. Each cartridge is machined, assembled, and functionally tested for continuous-duty industrial pressure.
features: ISO cavity compatibility with custom options
Stable response under continuous high-duty cycles

products.name: Solenoid Cartridge Valves
products.shortDescription: Electrically actuated cartridges for precise on/off and directional control in compact manifolds.
products.overview: HCV-SV solenoid cartridges combine wet-armature coils with hardened seats for reliable shifting in mobile and industrial circuits. Coil options support common industrial voltages.
features: 12 V, 24 V, and 110/220 V coil options

products.name: Check Valves
products.shortDescription: Low-leakage check cartridges that protect circuits and hold load with consistent cracking pressure.
products.overview: HCV-CK check valves are built for repeatable sealing in load-holding and isolation circuits. Poppet geometry is optimized for low pressure drop while remaining tight at rest.
features: Low pressure drop at rated flow

products.name: Relief Valves
products.shortDescription: Direct-acting and pilot-operated relief cartridges for stable system pressure protection.
products.overview: HCV-RV relief valves are specified where pressure must remain stable through load spikes. Direct-acting units serve compact circuits; pilot-operated designs handle higher flow with low override.
features: Optional vent and remote control ports

products.name: Flow Control Valves
products.shortDescription: Needle, pressure-compensated, and priority flow cartridges for controlled actuator speed.
products.overview: HCV-FC flow controls keep actuator velocity predictable as load changes. Compensated designs maintain set flow independent of downstream pressure within the rated window.

products.name: Directional Valves
products.shortDescription: Two-, three-, and four-way cartridge spools for compact directional control inside the manifold.
products.overview: HCV-DV directional cartridges reduce hose runs by placing function control inside the block. Spool and poppet logics cover motor, cylinder, and regenerative circuits.
features: Compact multi-function stacking in one block

products.name: Counterbalance Valves
products.shortDescription: Load-holding counterbalance cartridges for controlled lowering and overrunning loads.
products.overview: HCV-CB valves protect actuators from runaway motion. Pilot ratios and relief settings are selected to match cylinder area ratios and machine dynamics.

products.name: Custom Hydraulic Solutions
products.shortDescription: Application-specific cartridges, cavities, and manifold circuits built from your operating envelope.
products.overview: When a catalog cavity cannot meet envelope, duty, or integration requirements, the HCV-CX program develops custom cartridges and manifold circuits. Engineering reviews CAD, duty cycle, and fluid conditions before quoting.
features: Material and seal specification for duty

applications.name: Mobile Hydraulics
applications.shortDescription: Compact cartridges for vehicle-mounted systems that must hold pressure, shift cleanly, and survive vibration.
applications.overview: Mobile equipment demands dense manifolds, consistent valve response, and sealing that holds through shock and temperature swing. Cartridge architecture keeps circuits serviceable in the field.
solutions: Screw-in cartridges in compact steel blocks
Solenoid and load-holding functions grouped by circuit
Seal and material options for outdoor duty
applications.imageAlt: Heavy industrial metalwork associated with mobile equipment manufacturing

applications.name: Industrial Automation
applications.shortDescription: Repeatable pressure and directional control for presses, fixtures, and automated production cells.
applications.overview: Automated plants need valves that repeat the same motion thousands of times per shift. Cartridge manifolds reduce leak points and keep hydraulic logic close to the actuator.
solutions: Solenoid cartridges matched to industrial voltages
Relief and flow functions for stable process pressure
Custom blocks for fixture and press circuits

applications.name: Agriculture
applications.shortDescription: Durable flow and directional control for implements, steering, and auxiliary hydraulic functions.
applications.overview: Agricultural machines combine long idle periods with sudden high-load work. Valve selection focuses on contamination tolerance, simple service, and predictable implement speed.
solutions: Flow control for implement speed
Check and relief protection on shared pumps
Cartridge replacement without re-plumbing the machine
applications.imageAlt: Agricultural machinery operating in the field

applications.name: Construction Equipment
applications.shortDescription: Load-holding and pressure protection for booms, outriggers, and high-inertia work functions.
applications.overview: Construction hydraulics move heavy, overrunning loads. Counterbalance and relief cartridges are specified to keep motion controlled when gravity assists the actuator.
solutions: Counterbalance valves matched to cylinder ratios
Relief protection at 350 bar class
Hardened internals for abrasive duty
applications.imageAlt: Construction equipment on an active job site

applications.name: Material Handling
applications.shortDescription: Smooth lift, lower, and auxiliary control for warehouse and yard handling equipment.
applications.overview: Material handling systems need quiet, controlled motion and reliable load holding at rest. Cartridge valves keep lift circuits compact inside the vehicle or station manifold.
solutions: Load-holding check and counterbalance functions
Solenoid directional control for auxiliaries
Compensated flow for consistent lift speed

applications.name: Energy
applications.shortDescription: Pressure-stable cartridges for power generation auxiliaries, test stands, and process hydraulics.
applications.overview: Energy applications often combine high pressure with long hold times. Valve leakage, seal selection, and documented test results matter as much as catalog flow ratings.
solutions: Low-leakage check and relief cartridges
Functional testing on every unit in this catalog range
Custom manifolds for auxiliary power units

applications.name: Manufacturing
applications.shortDescription: Integrated hydraulic circuits for machine tools, forming equipment, and plant machinery.
applications.overview: Manufacturing OEMs specify cartridges to shorten machine build time and keep spares standardized. Custom blocks consolidate clamps, counters, and pressure sequences.
challenges: Dense function count in a small envelope
solutions: Multi-cavity manifolds from CAD
Standard screw-in families across machine lines
Flow and directional logic inside the block

applications.shortDescription: Application-engineered cartridges and cavities when standard catalog geometry is not enough.
applications.overview: Specialized machines often need unique porting, uncommon flow paths, or hybrid ISO/custom cavities. Engineering collaboration starts with the duty cycle, not a part number.
